exam.title: Implementing Analytics Solutions Using Microsoft Fabric
exam.study_prerequisites: Hands-on Microsoft Fabric and Power BI experience across lakehouses, warehouses, eventhouses, OneLake, SQL, KQL, Power Query, notebooks, dimensional modeling, DAX, semantic-model security/performance, Git and deployment pipelines.

review.notes: Every July 21, 2026 subobjective is mapped to a store, grain, transformation, query, identity/access layer, governance artifact, semantic-model behavior, lifecycle mechanism, performance signal, evidence, failure, or recovery decision. Three scenarios, eight labs and 36 original checks cover workspace/item/RLS/CLS/OLS/file controls, labels/endorsement, Git/PBIP/templates/PBIDS/shared models/deployment/XMLA/impact analysis, lakehouse/warehouse/eventhouse/OneLake/catalog/Real-Time hub, Dataflows/notebooks/T-SQL/star schemas/quality, SQL/KQL/DAX, storage modes/relationships/calculations/large models/Direct Lake/incremental refresh, performance and AI-ready semantics/Fabric IQ. All 16 URLs are cataloged: 14 reachable and two O'Reilly pages automation-blocked; none missing or broken. The guide records 23 hours 20 minutes of Learn paths, four-day course, free Practice Assessment and July 2026 gaps in older commercial resources.

findings.title: OneLake Direct Lake has no SQL fallback
findings.evidence: DirectLakeBehavior controls SQL-based models, while Direct Lake tables on OneLake do not fall back. Framing determines the visible version.
findings.recommendation: Replace generic fallback paragraph with variant table and original framing example.
findings.resolution: Replace generic fallback paragraph with variant table and original framing example.

findings.title: A restricted role does not cancel DefaultReader
findings.evidence: OneLake uses grants and broad virtual/default memberships can preserve access.
findings.recommendation: Add effective-membership worked example and engine/identity checks.
findings.resolution: Add effective-membership worked example and engine/identity checks.

findings.title: Declared Warehouse keys are not enforced
findings.evidence: Current primary, foreign and unique constraints require NOT ENFORCED.
findings.recommendation: Add duplicate-dimension join example and load-quality checks.
findings.resolution: Add duplicate-dimension join example and load-quality checks.

findings.title: Eventhouse OneLake availability is asynchronous and shares retention
findings.evidence: Default batching can delay writes up to three hours; retention and disabling availability affect exported representation.
findings.recommendation: Explain backfill, latency and lifecycle separately from KQL/report freshness.
findings.resolution: Explain backfill, latency and lifecycle separately from KQL/report freshness.

findings.title: Semantic export is not an RLS-filtered personal copy
findings.evidence: Import-table export depends on refresh, excludes calculated measure semantics and has distinct write/Read+Build access rules.

findings.title: USERELATIONSHIP does not activate inactive RLS propagation
findings.evidence: Official guidance says RLS propagates only through active relationships.
findings.recommendation: Add security condition to alternate-role modeling guidance.
findings.resolution: Add security condition to alternate-role modeling guidance.

findings.title: Incremental refresh does not automatically discover hard deletes
findings.evidence: Partition ranges need one inclusive boundary and change detection needs supported source changes.
findings.recommendation: Add boundary and deletion planning to the Import refresh section/lab.
findings.resolution: Add boundary and deletion planning to the Import refresh section/lab.

findings.title: Default result caching changes performance interpretation
findings.evidence: September GA docs describe opportunistic reuse and result_cache_hit evidence; RLS/DDM and other conditions can disqualify caching.

findings.title: Tenant ADBC controls do not switch the gateway path
findings.evidence: Transition covers named embedded-driver connectors with separate cloud/gateway behavior and planned rollout milestones.
findings.recommendation: Add migration comparison exercise and three automated follow-ups.
findings.resolution: Add migration comparison exercise and three automated follow-ups.
